preconditions.description: The number of horses n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of enemy pairs m must be non-negative and at most 3 times the number of horses.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in enemy_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair (ai, bi) must consist of valid horse indices and ai must not equal bi.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string of '0's and '1's of length n, or '-1' if no valid split is possible.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == '0' and stdout[j] == '0') or (stdout[i] == '1' and stdout[j] == '1') for i, j in enemy_pairs)
postconditions.description: No horse in the same party can have more than one enemy in that party.
